reuse.why: Reuses linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank and unlinkAccount for Fintegra and takeover, but the new guards are not placed in the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount path, and the Fintegra download is a fresh copy of the Akahu downloader instead of a shared one.

duplication.why: Every one of the six provider link functions repeats the same ensureAccountIsOpen + ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked pair with its own provider literal, and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions almost line for line.

placement.why: Guard helpers live in the accounts app next to linking, which fits, but the link rules sit at each provider entry point rather than in the common linkBankSyncAccount layer that all providers already funnel through.

scope.why: Edits are limited to linking, Fintegra plumbing (server config, provider list, types, sync dispatch) and tests; a duplicated send.mockClear() in the test is the only noise.

maintainability.why: Adding a provider or a new link rule requires remembering to call both guards in each provider function, so the rules can easily drift; the unlinkAccount flag is a reasonable but extra knob.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The link rules are called from linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkEnableBankingAccount and linkFintegraAccount instead of inside the shared linkBankSyncAccount (or a single wrapper around it).

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated guard calls and the copied Fintegra downloader are verbatim repetitions, not reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: LinkAccountBaseParams gains replaceExistingLink and unlinkAccount gains suppressProviderCleanup with a new early-return branch; the six provider link functions each apply the link rules themselves rather than through linkBankSyncAccount.
